options.content: **Faro events** use label `telemetry_source=faro` (JSON lines from the browser SDK). **Nginx access logs** for the frontend container are plain text — do not run `| json` on them (that causes `JSONParserErr`). Enable `M8FLOW_FRONTEND_FARO_COLLECTOR_URL=http://localhost:6865/collect` and rebuild/restart the frontend for Faro data.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Faro exception events (browser errors) per second. Computed directly from the Faro JSON logs via LogQL — Alloy's faro.receiver only emits logs and traces, never Prometheus metrics, so there is no faro_errors_total (or any faro_* metric) to query.

panels.title: Session count
panels.description: Distinct Faro session_id values seen in the selected time range. Computed from Faro JSON logs via LogQL (see Error rate panel note).

panels.title: Web Vitals: LCP p75
panels.description: p75 Largest Contentful Paint (ms) from Faro web-vitals measurements, via LogQL unwrap + quantile_over_time (see Error rate panel note). Picked LCP specifically since other vitals (CLS, INP, etc.) use different units and can't be quantiled together meaningfully.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {telemetry_source="faro"} | json | kind="measurement" | unwrap value_LCP [$__range]) or vector(0)

panels.title: Faro browser events
panels.description: Only telemetry from the Faro collector (JSON). Tenant filter applies when user attributes are present.

panels.title: Frontend container (nginx) access logs
panels.description: Docker stdout from the frontend image — not Faro. Shown without JSON parsing.
